name: io.github.telemcp/telemcp
title: telemcp
description: Self-hosted Telegram MCP server: read, search and send with your own account or a bot.

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_API_ID
environmentVariables.description: Your own api_id from my.telegram.org (API development tools). Not needed after `telemcp login` saved it.

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_API_HASH
environmentVariables.description: Your own api_hash from my.telegram.org. Not needed after `telemcp login` saved it.

environmentVariables.name: TELEMCP_BOT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Run as a Telegram bot with this token from @BotFather instead of a user account.

environmentVariables.name: TELEMCP_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Data directory for the session, config.json and the local database. Default ~/.telemcp.

environmentVariables.name: TELEMCP_BOT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Run as a Telegram bot with this token from @BotFather.
